stage1_manifest_jsonl.description: Row-based manifest for Stage-1 VQ-VAE training and 4D latent extraction.

required_fields.image: Path to a 4D fMRI clip file. Relative paths are resolved against the JSONL file directory by the public Stage-1 scripts.
required_fields.subject: Subject identifier.

optional_fields.image_key: Key used when the source file is an NPZ archive.
optional_fields.layout: Input layout for the 4D array; supported values are xyzt and txyz.

stage2_universal_split_csv.description: CSV format for next-only latent prediction. Each row pairs an anchor latent with the next-window target latent and an anchor FC embedding.

required_fields.Subject: Subject identifier.
required_fields.latent_path: Anchor latent path. Relative paths are resolved against the CSV file directory by the public Stage-2 scripts.
required_fields.fc_embedding_path: FC embedding path for the anchor window. Relative paths are resolved against the CSV file directory by the public Stage-2 scripts.
required_fields.target_latent_path: Target latent path for the next window. Relative paths are resolved against the CSV file directory by the public Stage-2 scripts.
